name: GP prediction-error model
description: Empirical SGP4 prediction error by orbit regime and prediction age, in RTN. Element sets are propagated to later element sets of the same object (consecutive-set differences, which are not truth) or to independent reference states (GCRF, from analysis/reference-states). Batches accumulate counts, moments and histograms; finalize gives mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma and clipped covariance per stratum. With a model on accumulate (reference mode), each error is also tested against its stratum's model covariance (Mahalanobis d^2 against chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom, every sample counted) and finalize gates each stratum CALIBRATED, FAILED or INSUFFICIENT; scale_model fits per-stratum scale factors to reference-state errors. screening_evaluation scores a probabilistic (Foster Pc), a bounded-set and a possibility (admissible-set) screening rule on independent cases built from reference-state errors with synthetic true misses. screening_cases scores the same rules on caller-supplied pairs, each object with its own covariance. common_epoch propagates element sets of one object to common epochs and returns each one's RTN difference from an origin there (a reference state, their mean, or one set). map_covariance maps an RTN covariance through a state transition matrix: SGP4's (central differences in nonsingular mean elements), two-body (complex-step Kepler) or the Lambert arc of Thompson et al. (2019). ffm_arcs and ffm_coverage calibrate FFM (Full Force Model) covariance (P0 at the element-set epoch, white-acceleration process noise) against reference states. pair_statistics, fit_calibration, calibrate_covariance and dcp_covariance (orbit-accuracy-experiments E14) give the error and Mahalanobis statistics of predicted against truth states, fit covariance calibration factors per stratum, apply a frozen covariance model (operator-file factors by regime and horizon, or an element-set model by regime and age) to objects in RTN and inertial axes, and form the density-forecast consider covariance (an open Dynamic Consider Parameter). fit_elements fits SGP4 mean elements (an OMM, optionally B*) to an ephemeris by weighted Levenberg-Marquardt differential correction in equinoctial elements, with exact residual statistics on every state, a half-split closure test and the fit covariance; element_residuals scores element sets against an ephemeris over time windows. Typed contracts 1.0 (FlatBuffers only, no JSON): every model, accumulator, option, request and report port carries one SDS Orbit Error Model ($ERM) record with the matching arm set (MODEL, ACCUMULATOR, STRATA_SETTINGS, GATE, SCALE_OPTIONS, SCREENING_SETTINGS, SCREENING_CASES, SCREENING_REPORT, ARC_OPTIONS, ARC_PLAN, ARC_PREDICTIONS, COVERAGE_OPTIONS, PROPAGATOR_COVERAGE, COMMON_EPOCH, COVARIANCE_MAP, PAIR_STATISTICS, CALIBRATION, CALIBRATED_COVARIANCES, CONSIDER_COVARIANCES, NOISE_RESPONSES, ELEMENT_FITS, ATTACH_REPORT); the catalog-pipeline products are $OMM, $OCM and $MNV with $CVR and $PVN. attach_covariance and attribute_maneuvers read their recipe from the node config (plugin.getConfig, one ModuleConfig): keys under "attach." and "attribute." (a flow configures several nodes), else the same keys at the root; attach_covariance takes its models as $ERM MODEL records on the models port.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 propagation and statistics over caller-supplied element sets and reference states. One host call, plugin.getConfig (attach_covariance and attribute_maneuvers read their recipe from the node config); no threads or network access; batches are combined through the prior accumulator.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM records, concatenated, SGP4 mean elements; every element set of each object in the batch (objects are not split across batches). Epochs within one second are one element set republished: the later record is kept.
Independent reference states ($OEM, GCRF, UTC, OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID), e.g. analysis/reference-states output. When present, errors are taken against these instead of later element sets.
One $ERM MODEL record (form StratifiedStatistics: finalize or scale_model output) whose position covariance each reference-mode sample is tested against.

One $ERM STRATA_SETTINGS record: regimes, age bins, reference step and clip; empty lists mean the defaults (ten regimes by mean altitude and eccentricity, six age bins to 7 days, 300 s step, no clip).
One $ERM ACCUMULATOR record from an earlier batch with the same strata, mode and clip, added to.

outputPorts.description: One $ERM ACCUMULATOR record: the accumulator after this batch.

outputPorts.description: One $ERM MODEL record, form StratifiedStatistics: per stratum mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma, clipped statistics and coverage.

outputPorts.description: One $ERM MODEL record: the model with scaled position covariance and per-stratum factors (SCALE).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The element sets as published, ORIGINATOR the producer (the message's creator), PROVENANCE naming the source, COVARIANCE (RTN lower triangle) of the row nearest the epoch with COV_REFERENCE_FRAME RSW, and that row's CVR in COV_REALISM.

outputPorts.description: The element sets as published, ORIGINATOR the producer (the message's creator), PROVENANCE naming the source, COVARIANCE (RTN lower triangle) of the row nearest the epoch with COV_REFERENCE_FRAME RSW, and that row's CVR in COV_REALISM.

One $ERM ATTACH_REPORT record: the source (PVN), per object the rule that applied, why the earlier rules did not, every row's CVR label and verdict, the SHA-256 of each record; refused and unmatched records.

methods.description: Gives every object's product a covariance by the first rule that applies: the operator's as supplied, a fit's formal covariance times the realism factor measured for its source and class, the source's own model of its element sets' error by regime and age, or the pooled model. Writes it into $OCM and $OMM with its CVR (COV_REALISM): the rule, the model or factor, the regime and age cell, and the numbers of the held-out test, Calibrated only where those numbers pass the realism rule (mean d2/3 in [0.8, 1.25], 95 % coverage in [0.93, 0.97], from at least 30 samples of 3 objects) on the source's lineage, else Uncalibrated. Every record names its source in PROVENANCE (PVN).

methods.displayName: Fit SGP4 mean elements to an ephemeris

inputPorts.description: The ephemeris: $OEM (size-prefixed or not), each block with OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID, REFERENCE_FRAME TEME, GCRF, ICRF, EME2000 or J2000, TIME_SYSTEM UTC, TAI, TT or GPS, states as lines or the compact form, optional covariance lines.
Optional a priori $OMM sets (size-prefixed, concatenated): the source of B* when it is not fitted, or the starting elements with initial = apriori.

One $ERM ELEMENT_FITS record with OPTIONS: SHARED settings for every object, FITS per object (each overrides the shared settings where it differs from them); without it, every object of the ephemeris is fitted with the defaults.

outputPorts.description: The fitted element sets. Absent when no fit converged.
One $ERM ELEMENT_FITS record with FITS (the fitted element sets are the companion elements port).
